capabilities.label: Core interfaces and numerical primitives
capabilities.description: Functional grouping for core interfaces and numerical primitives.

capabilities.label: Detection and segmentation models
capabilities.description: Functional grouping for detection and segmentation models.

capabilities.label: Configuration and object construction
capabilities.description: Define, compose, migrate and instantiate model and training configurations using both the legacy configuration tree and Python LazyConfig.

features.label: Legacy configuration trees
features.description: Load and merge YAML settings, defaults and command-line overrides with CfgNode.

features.label: Version migration
features.description: Upgrade or downgrade historical configuration keys through compatibility converters.

features.label: Lazy configuration graphs
features.description: Load Python configurations and compose LazyCall object descriptions.

features.label: Dependency instantiation
features.description: Resolve nested configured objects into constructor calls through instantiate.

features.label: Configurable constructors
features.description: Adapt explicit keyword constructors to configuration-driven callers.

capabilities.label: Image and prediction data structures
capabilities.description: Represent batches of differently sized images and structured detections while retaining coordinate, indexing and device-transfer semantics.

features.label: Bounding-box geometry
features.description: Axis-aligned and rotated boxes support clipping, scaling, overlap and coordinate conversions.

features.label: Instance records
features.description: Keep aligned fields such as labels, scores, boxes, masks and keypoints in an Instances container.

features.label: Image batching
features.description: Pad varying image sizes with ImageList and preserve each original image shape.

features.label: Mask representations
features.description: Represent polygon masks, bit masks and region masks with conversion and crop operations.

features.label: Keypoint representation
features.description: Transform annotated points between image coordinates and heatmap targets.

capabilities.label: Shared neural-network and tensor operations
capabilities.description: Supply reusable convolution blocks, normalization, tensor wrappers, ordinary ROI alignment and suppression, and native-extension registration.

features.label: Normalization choices
features.description: Provide frozen batch normalization, synchronized variants and configurable normalization factories.

features.label: Reusable image blocks
features.description: Compose convolution blocks, depthwise-separable convolutions and atrous spatial pyramid pooling.

features.label: Tensor shape and empty-input support
features.description: Track feature shapes and preserve tensor operations across empty batches and tracing contexts.

features.label: ROI alignment and suppression
features.description: Pool axis-aligned regions and perform class-aware non-maximum suppression.

features.label: Regression losses and native bridge
features.description: Provide DIoU/CIoU helpers and the binding layer used by optional compiled operators.

capabilities.label: Model construction, matching and output geometry
capabilities.description: Provide the shared detector assembly interfaces and geometric operations used by multiple independent model families.

features.label: Registry-based construction
features.description: Build meta-architectures and backbones through registered constructors.

features.label: Anchors and box transforms
features.description: Generate axis-aligned or rotated anchors and convert between box coordinates and regression targets.

features.label: Target matching and sampling
features.description: Assign ground truth with configurable thresholds and sample foreground/background examples.

features.label: Common dense-detector behavior
features.description: Normalize images, arrange feature predictions and dispatch training or inference for dense detectors.

features.label: Output postprocessing
features.description: Rescale boxes, masks and semantic outputs back to requested image coordinates.

capabilities.label: Packaging and developer workflows
capabilities.description: Install the library, build native extensions and documentation, and maintain the project with developer checks.

capabilities.label: Runtime services and interoperability
capabilities.description: Shared environment initialization, registries, distributed communication, logging, file access, serialization and tracing compatibility.

features.label: Environment and reproducibility
features.description: Initialize supported libraries, apply optional environment setup, seed Python/NumPy/PyTorch, and describe the runtime environment.

features.label: Registries and object lookup
features.description: Register components and resolve configurable object paths used across the library.

features.label: Multi-process communication
features.description: Expose rank/world-size helpers, synchronization, object gathering, shared random seeds and reduction of metric dictionaries.

features.label: Files, logs and serialization
features.description: Resolve detectron2:// resources through PathManager, configure bounded logging helpers, and wrap callable objects for pickling.

features.label: Memory and tracing compatibility
features.description: Retry CUDA out-of-memory operations, expose version predicates, and use tracing-compatible assertions.

capabilities.label: Python package and native-extension builds
capabilities.description: Build and install Detectron2, compile its CPU/CUDA operators and include model-zoo configuration resources.

features.label: Package metadata
features.description: Resolve the distribution version and install requirements and package contents.

features.label: Native extension build
features.description: Compile registered C++/CUDA sources with the selected toolkit, architecture and build flags.

features.label: Config resources
features.description: Include or link model-zoo configuration files in the installed package.

features.label: Wheel publishing helpers
features.description: Build wheel matrices and generate installation tables and wheel indexes for supported environments.
